title: One watch history per person, and Continue watching, from the server.
description: Serves Goal 3: "Octave's features have the server they need."; "Their place is always one press away.". Split from JS-186 (D-20261127-domains-tasks).
acceptanceCriteria: Each person has one watch history per title, across devices and versions.

Continue watching is decided by the server and is the same on every device: titles in progress and each show's next episode, including a show the viewer had caught up on when a new episode arrives; a title leaves it when the viewer removes it or finishes it; nothing leaves by age; removing a title keeps the viewer's place (#101, #233).
Every capability it adds is in the published contract (JS-183) and passes its conformance check.
A title marked played by hand keeps its place and gets it back when unmarked. A title played to its end has no place to return, and starts from the beginning.
notes: Criteria are JS-186's criteria 3 and 4 plus the contract criterion. Phase M1 chosen (split from JS-186, M1); ux flag chosen: true. Amended 2026-11-27 by D-20261127-played-by-hand-keeps-place and D-20261127-continue-watching-no-age-window, decided by the product owner: criterion 4 added; criterion 2 changed, so nothing leaves Continue watching by age.
